column1: # openalexPro ecosystem manifest
# Columns: name <TAB> url <TAB> default-branch <TAB> kind
# `name` is the LOCAL DIRECTORY, which need not match the repository name. The
# org's `.github` repo is cloned into `dot-github/` so that a hidden directory
# is not mistaken for this repository's own GitHub config, and so that `.github/`
# stays free for that actual purpose. `make clone` passes name as the clone
# target, so the mapping needs no special handling.
# kind is one of:
#   r-package  an R package. Every target covers it, including `make install`,
#              `make test` and `make check`.
#   support    infrastructure repo, not an R package. The git targets (status,
#              audit, clone, fetch, pull) cover it; the R build targets skip it.
# ORDER MATTERS for the r-package rows: this is dependency order. `make
# install`, `make test` and `make check` walk the file top to bottom, so
# openalexPro must come first. Keep the support rows at the end.
# URLs are SSH throughout so pushes do not prompt. Note that some existing
# local clones still use HTTPS remotes — see ecosystem.md ("Remote URLs").
# Only `make clone` reads the url column, so the mismatch is harmless.
# Repos deliberately absent: openalexStemCheck (not a git repository) and
# openalexASReview (no remote, slated for retirement). See ecosystem.md.
# Also in the org but not cloned here: openalex-snapshot (Rust CLI) and
# openalexpro.r-universe.dev (r-universe build config).
# name
openalexPro
openalexSnapshot
openalexConvert
openalexSnowball
openalexVectorComp
dot-github
openalexpro.github.io
